description: Edit your XeroHost game server files and use its console and power controls from VS Code.
config.console.prompt: Prompt shown in front of console messages and replacing the panel's default prompt.
config.files.downloadThresholdMiB: Files larger than this are opened through a signed download link instead of the panel's file contents endpoint.
config.files.pollIntervalSeconds: Every how many seconds to check for changes made outside VS Code (in the panel, by other people or by the server itself) in the folders VS Code is watching. `0` turns it off; values between 1 and 2 are treated as 3. Paused while the window is not focused. Use **XeroHost: Refresh** to check on demand.
terminal.profile.title: XeroHost Console
